actions.action: Scratch base of pseudostem and check corm/roots for firmness or rot
Water to keep soil evenly damp but not soggy, ensuring drainage
Move plant to bright shade/filtered light out of afternoon sun and wind
If pseudostem is mushy, cut it back to firm tissue leaving a few-inch stump
